name: 1047 Commonwealth
about:
Discover the ultimate in convenience at 1047 Commonwealth, a modern student housing in Boston. Located in the heart of Boston's vibrant Allston neighbourhood, 1047 Commonwealth Avenue is steps away from Boston University West Campus and a 13-minute cycling to Northeastern University. 1047 Commonwealth is a 6-story building offering 183 fully furnished studio apartments designed for students and young professionals who value privacy, efficiency, and style. 1047 Commonwealth is a "Walker’s Paradise" with a Transit Score of 96. The Babcock Street Station (Green B line) is just a 2-minute walk away, connecting you instantly to BU Central and downtown, while balancing convenient campus access with vibrant city life.Fully Furnished Living 
1047 Commonwealth Avenue offers a range of furnished studios (322-528 Sq Ft) and welcomes undergraduate students. Each apartment features high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows, providing ample natural light, Wi-Fi, and central air conditioning.
Complete Furniture Package: Each unit comes with a nightstand, dresser drawers, a desk and chair, a coffee table in the living area, a queen- or twin-sized bed with a mattress and pillow, and lounge chairs. sparing you the trouble of buying and assembling furniture.
Private Amenities: relish the private space of your own kitchen, complete with premium wooden cabinets, a stainless steel refrigerator, microwave, dishwasher, and oven. The separate bathroom features a contemporary design and excellent privacy.
In-Unit Laundry: A washer and dryer are included in every 1047 Commonwealth apartment, which is an uncommon luxury in Boston rentals.All-Inclusive Student LifestyleAt 1047 Commonwealth apartments in Boston, we redefine student living by taking care of the details.Utility Package: Your rent includes water, gas, and heating. No surprise bills.Community Perks: Elevate your downtime on the rooftop deck with stunning Boston skyline views, or socialise in the lounge with billiards, coffee bar and fireplace.Study & Play: Focus on your GPA in the quiet study rooms, or blow off steam in the fully equipped fitness centre and game room. 1047 Commonwealth offers a variety of luxurious shared amenities to support students' collegiate life. Safety First: With 24-hour security, keyless entry, and a heated parking garage, 1047 Commonwealth Residence offers total peace of mind.Location & What's Hot
The address—1047 Commonwealth Avenue—is your greatest asset. You are located in the famous "Green District" of Allston, a hub for foodies and students, there are a variety of restaurants, Asian supermarkets, cafes, and museums right at your doorstep. Whether it's for daily errands or exploring Boston on the weekends, this is the ideal starting point.
Hotspots nearby 1047 Commonwealth:
Restaurants: There are 3 restaurants within 0.7 miles of 1047 Commonwralth: Kaojiu Restaurant, Zaftigs Delicatessen, and BELL86 (Korean restaurant).
Bars: you'll find live music at House of Blues/Bill's Bar, sports/shopping at Fenway Park (Red Sox Store), classic pubs like Cornwall's,
Shopping centre: Memorial Plaza is 1.2 miles away from 1047 Commonwealth. Need tech or snacks? A short trip brings you to Micro Centre and Trader Joe's. 
Groceries: You are directly across from Star Market (a major plus for snowy winters) and just a 3-minute walk from Super 88 for unparalleled Asian cuisine and groceries.
Entertainment near 1047 Commonwealth, Boston MA
Living at 1047 Commonwealth Avenue puts you right in the heart of Kenmore Square, where residents can easily access museums and some iconic spots in Boston. The Freedom Trail, which offers a trip through the city's famous sites, is just ten minutes away. The Boston Symphony Orchestra is only 2.8 miles away for an evening of top-notch performances, and art enthusiasts can drive to the Harvard Art Museums in less than ten minutes. Agganis Arena is five minutes away, making it ideal for sporting events and concerts, and Paradise Rock Club is just a three-minute walk for nightlife and live music. Nickerson Field is only a seven-minute walk away for outdoor activities and sporting events, and Boston University's Fitness and Recreation Centre is conveniently located just six minutes on foot for students and fitness enthusiasts. Transportation 
The 1047 building is just a 2-minute walk to the MBTA Green Line (B Line) and bus stops, providing easy access to downtown Boston. Convenient bus access: 1079 Commonwealth Ave and 19 Brighton Ave are the nearest bus stations; residents have access to the 57 bus and other major routes right outside the 1047 Commonwealth apartments.Green Line (B): The Babcock Street Station is literally at your doorstep, connecting you instantly to BU Central, Northeastern University, Emerson College, and Downtown Boston.Boston Landing: The Commuter Rail station is nearby for weekend getaways, just 1.1 miles away from 1047 Commonwealth.
Ready to upgrade your semester? Choose 1047 Commonwealth Avenue for a secure, stylish, and stress-free living experience.

about:
LightView is a premier student housing in Boston, located at 744 Columbus Avenue in the heart of the city, the convenient location offers easy access to Northeastern University(4 minutes walk), Boston University(10 minutes by bicycle), and Berklee College of Music(8-minute drive). LightView apartments feature fully furnished 1-to 4-bedroom units for students, offering an elevated experience for residents. All daily necessities, such as restaurants, shops, and recreational attractions. If you have further to go, Tremont St @ Burke St is the nearest bus stop, within a 2-minute walk from the student housing.FeaturesLightView Boston puts student wellness first, offering lifestyle-enhancing comforts to support a balanced, fulfilling life. Each unit features hardwood-style flooring and a modern kitchen fully loaded with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. Each LightView apartment has central heat and air, so you're always in control of the temperature. Love having friends over? The living room has a leather-style sectional sofa. It's basically made for movie nights. The private (1 bed & 2 bed) or shared (3 bed & 4 bed) bathroom comes with convenient curved shower rods and sleek hardwood-style floors for easy cleaning. We've got on-site laundry to make life easier, and whether you're flying solo or want roommates, LightView Boston offers floor plans from 1 to 4 bedrooms. With the internet included in every apartment, you can access online resources and and your favorite shows on Nexflix. Living in LightView, everything is covered in your rent; you don't need to worry about electricity, water, internet, or even your trash. Lightview is where academic ambition meets everyday ease, with building amenities designed to help you succeed and find work-life balance. Find your focus in our 24-hour Academic Success Centre, equipped with iMacs and free printing. When it’s time to recharge, the property has a 24-hour recreation centre. Through educational, social, and recreational activities, you can connect with your neighbourhood, find shared interests, and unwind right at home. Lightview is a safe student housing; residents can live with peace of mind. The building is equipped with 24-hour on-call staff, a courtesy desk, and professional on-site management. Enjoy the convenience of roommate matching, flexible leases, an on-site package centre, and the security of a limited-access community with individual liability leases.
At Light View Boston, we’ve built more than a residence—we’ve built a foundation for your future.Location and What's Hot?Located in the heart of Boston, student life in LightView is full of fun and convenience. Emerson College is 11 minutes away by bus, the New England Conservatory of Music is 8 minutes walk away, the Wentworth Institute of Technology is 15 minutes walk away and the Massachusetts College of Art and Design (5 minutes away by car). Students studying in these universities also choose to rent LightView's rooms. There are many high-level restaurants and coffee shops near the LightView apartments in Boston. For example, Bangkok Pinto is popular Thai restaurants within 5 minutes walk from the building, Five Guys is a fast food restaurant 10 minutes walk away, their all-beef hot dog is delicious, and their melted cheese and grilled onions are a great combo! Dudley Cafe is a good place to enjoy a tasty brunch, it’s also right next to a major bus terminal, so you can come in while you wait and sip or much. Cooking for yourself? Whole Foods Market and Tropical Foods (El Platanero) are two supermarkets nearby LightView, where you can find a wide selection of goods and food. From happy hour to late night, Slades Bar & Grill is where Boston's student crowd connects, just a 3-minute walk from the LightView. Snell Library and Curry Student Center also steps away from the building. Boston can be regarded as a paradise for history enthusiasts. It is filled with museums and historical sites.
